newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Hindalco posts fall in 1996/97 net profit.
newsitem.headline: India's Hindalco posts fall in 1996/97 net profit.

text.p: India's largest private aluminium maker Hindalco on Monday posted a fall in its net profit to 3.91 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March), down from 4.01 billion in the previous year.
The company warned shareholders a month ago that production losses due to power supply problems and low global aluminium prices would cause a slight drop in profits.
Hindalco said net sales in 1996/97 fell to 11.57 billion rupees from 12.52 billion in the previous year.
Earnings per share were cut to 52.5 rupees from 80.79 in the previous year. But the company raised its dividend to 4.5 rupees from 4.0.
Aluminium production fell to 166,272 tonnes in 1996/97 from 175,398 tonnes the year before.
Output of rolled products dropped sharply to 18,302 tonnes from 31,378.
